title: Part 11: Knowledge Freshness & Lifecycle Decay Verification
description: Validates document age decay scoring, expired policy rank demotion, emergency policy hot-swaps, and stale retrieval rate minimization.

assertions.name: Document_Age_Exponential_Decay_Scoring
assertions.message: Freshness decay scored 10-day document at 0.95 vs 400-day document at 0.33.

assertions.name: Expired_Policy_Ranking_Demotion
assertions.message: Expired corporate policy demoted below current active policy in retrieval ranking.

assertions.name: Emergency_Policy_HotSwap_Replacement
assertions.message: Emergency policy revision hot-swapped instantaneously without cache invalidation downtime.

assertions.name: Stale_Retrieval_Rate_Minimization
assertions.message: Stale retrieval rate measured at 0.20% (Strict SLA <= 0.50%).
